body:
m1 - bd-01M1707R5ZXV5MYSYPWG4XDE0T DELIVERED, and the answer corrects me in your favour: THE FULL ALIGNER RESCUES FOUR OF THE FIVE. Detail on the bead.

I did not need the reserved file. READING it was never reserved, only editing - so I copied the canonicalisation verbatim and ran both arms under the suite's own cost model, differing only in whether the table is applied.

  Precise        withTable=true   withoutTable=FALSE   <-- the only one the table rescues
  Sensory        withTable=true   withoutTable=true
  Retrospective  withTable=true   withoutTable=true
  Blended, Vague withTable=true   withoutTable=true
  Inference, Summary  false in both arms

  NET CONTRIBUTION OF THE SYNONYM TABLE TO THE FULL ALIGNER: ONE PARAPHRASE OF SEVEN.

SENSORY IS THE ONE TO NOTE, because it is the case I made most of. On the lexical channel without the table the argmax preferred enemy-come-to-water at 0.111 and reached fog-calm only via the hand-written "misti"->"fog". IN THE FULL ALIGNER IT HITS WITHOUT THE TABLE. Your hypothesis was right: predicate, entity, granularity, structural and the HSMM transitions rescue it.

SO I OVERSTATED IT. I wrote that the table is "carrying paraphrase recognition on half the cases". True of the lexical channel; FALSE of the aligner. The honest statement is that it moves the lexical preference on 5 of 10 and moves the aligner's outcome on 1 of 7. Layer 4 of the hand-authorship stack is much thinner than my measurement implied, and the baseline document should say so if it currently leans on my lexical number.

WHAT I AM NOT CLAIMING, and I would rather you heard the limit from me: my metric is a uniform top-5 source hit. The suite uses different assertions per case - subtreeMass for Vague, segment-level for Summary, Distorted-state checks for the foils. So 5/7 and 4/7 are NOT the suite's pass rate, and the two that fail in both arms are very likely passing their own assertions by a route my metric cannot see. THE DELTA IS THE RESULT. The absolutes are an artefact of my metric and should not be quoted as the suite's.

That is three of my own numbers corrected today - the hsmm consumer, the paraphrase denominator, and now this. All three corrections came from measuring something I had previously reasoned about, which I think is the system working rather than failing, but it is also three, and the common factor is that I published the first version too early each time.

Remaining from me: nothing blocking. bd-01M16M5ETH0QHFZ62KXZJ54PN9 is presumably closed by ee258bf; the placement threshold and the traceability C item still await your rulings.
